notes.title: 1.135 - Colour themes and collection support
notes.notes:
With this update, all copies of my books on Steam have been converted to the more feature-rich standards of my NB Book Binder program.

What this means in practical terms is that you can now change colour theme via the settings menu, or manually create a colour theme by editing the "theme.xml" file found in the installation folder.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43278483/118663bc8d3c81c7651b13c5430ccd3e4ca89957.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43278483/ac44ab796d2562100f472ed5fd5e604a7a0b6325.jpg[/img]

You can also manually create collections, if you'd like to consolidate my series of books (or anyone else packaging books with the NB Book Binder). Refer to the "To Create A Collection" text file found in the Documents folder of your installation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43278483/3eef20b27f15282fabcca6105cf3b92c4383b2e5.jpg[/img]

While I've driven myself insane testing things, I'm only one man, and as such there may be unexpected side-effects of this rather substantial conversion, so let me know if anything goes... a bit peculiar. Other than me.

notes.title: The Pilgrimage launch
notes.notes:
The Pilgrimage, a parser-driven text adventure based upon these here literary works, is now available on Steam! Acquire it for free now or any time before its final chapter is written, and it's yours to keep forever. Furthermore, launch Tales From The Burning Sea at least once, and the book will be available to read inside The Pilgrimage, found upon a shelf in one of the game's environments!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/687860/The_Pilgrimage/]The Pilgrimage[/url]

notes.title: Unification patch
notes.notes:
In anticipation of the (hopefully) impending launch of The Pilgrimage, all associated products have been updated to share the same data structure. Which is a fancy way of saying, all your previous saved data has been rendered invalid... but moving forward, this should never happen again, and all saved data will be compatible across different products and for all future versions.

In other words, if you own one of my books, and have launched it at least once, all other products will remember, will be able to load your bookmark, and will remember your screen settings.

Version number has, as such, reset to 1.0 across the board, and all subsequent version increments will match (with a slight delay in minutes relative to how quickly I mark builds as live).

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.notes: All demo content is now packaged in the main product - and will be updated to include samples of any upcoming titles in future.
